title: One Bag
audience: DRAFT, confirm or rewrite: myself, and the friend who was waiting for me that night. We watch it on a phone.
intent: DRAFT, confirm or rewrite: we should remember that night the way it was, confusing and new, and be glad we lived it. Experience it.

style.block: Hand-painted gouache illustration with soft visible brush strokes and warm paper grain. The painting fills the whole frame from edge to edge. Muted earth palette with amber and teal accents. Gentle rim light, simple shapes, picture-book composition with the subject in the centre of the frame. No writing or lettering anywhere in the picture: number plates, shop signs and screens are plain blank shapes.
style.negative: text, letters, signs with writing, watermark, logo, photorealistic, extra fingers

characters.label: The author in 2019
characters.description: A slim Ethiopian young man of about nineteen with dark brown skin and short black curly hair, wearing a plain dark jacket over a light shirt, plain trousers and moulded plastic sandals with a closed toe and a buckle strap, carrying one simple backpack.
characters.reference_prompt: One single full-length figure on a plain warm background, seen from behind, standing in a neutral pose with his backpack on his shoulders, his feet and sandals in view. Only one figure in the picture.

characters.label: The friend who knew the city
characters.description: An Ethiopian young man of about the same age, a little taller, with dark brown skin and short black hair, always seen from behind, wearing a blue denim jacket and carrying nothing.
characters.reference_prompt: One single full-length figure on a plain warm background, seen from behind, standing in a neutral pose with empty hands. Only one figure in the picture.

characters.label: The author today
characters.description: The same man seven years later, in his mid twenties, with dark brown skin and short black curly hair, calm, wearing a plain shirt, always seen from behind.

voice.name: Charon
voice.style: calm, warm and unhurried, like telling a memory to family

music.caption: Solo krar, the Ethiopian six-string lyre, plucked slowly. A sparse pentatonic melody in the tizita mood. One instrument only, in a quiet room. No drums, no vocals.

cues.note: Krar alone, very quiet. Midday, the goodbye.
The melody opens up with the road and the mountains.
Night in the city: the melody thins out, a low drone enters.
The busiest moment, the brokers. Still quiet under the voice.
Back to the krar alone. The room.
The first melody returns and resolves. Fade under the end card.

lines: Images, voice and music were generated by AI models.
A true story by Bete Goshme

shots.title: Midday, Ankober
shots.reason: Where it starts: a small highland town at midday and one backpack. The goodbye is said in the voice, because the friend who came to say it is not shown.

keyframe.prompt: Midday in a small town in the Ethiopian highlands. One young man seen from behind, in the centre, a simple backpack on his shoulders, stands facing an old boxy country bus with its door open and bundles tied on its roof rack. Low houses with rusty corrugated tin roofs and mud-plastered walls, tall thin eucalyptus trees, red-brown dusty ground, high bright sun, short shadows. Nobody else in the foreground.

motion.prompt: He shifts the backpack on his shoulders and steps toward the bus door. Fixed camera.

narration.am: እኩለ ቀን አካባቢ ነበር፣ ከአንኮበር ስነሳ። አንድ የጀርባ ቦርሳ ብቻ ይዤ። አንድ ጓደኛዬ ሊሸኘኝ መጥቶ ነበር።
narration.en: It was around midday when I left Ankober. Just one backpack. A friend had come to see me off.

review.note: Draft written on 2026-11-25 from the story Bete told by voice that day. He has not read this line yet. The year is left out until he says whether it was before or after 12 September 2019: in Amharic it has to be the Ethiopian year, in words.

shots.title: The gravel road
shots.reason: The journey itself, and the scale of it: one small bus on a gravel road under forested mountains. He said the view was amazing, so the shot is wide and takes its time.

keyframe.prompt: Extreme wide view from high above: a pale gravel road winds along steep green mountainsides in the Ethiopian highlands. One tiny country bus on the road trails a long plume of dust. Dense dark green juniper and eucalyptus forest on the slopes, layer after layer of mountains fading into blue haze, early afternoon light. No people.

motion.prompt: The small bus moves slowly along the road and its dust drifts away. Slow pan to the right.

narration.am: እስከ ደብረ ብርሃን መንገዱ ፒስታ ነበር። ከዚያ በኋላ አስፋልት።
narration.en: The road was gravel as far as Debre Birhan. After that, asphalt.

review.note: Draft written on 2026-11-25 from the story Bete told by voice that day. He has not read this line yet.

shots.title: The window seat
shots.reason: The same journey from where he sat. Nobody travelled with him, so the shot is his alone: a window, and what was outside it.

keyframe.prompt: Inside an old country bus. In the foreground, seen from behind, one young passenger sits on a worn bus seat beside the side window: only his head, his shoulders and the top of the seat back are in view, and he holds a backpack on his lap. He looks out through the side window at steep forested mountain slopes of the Ethiopian highlands in afternoon light. A row of bus windows runs along the wall.

motion.prompt: Forest and mountain slopes slide slowly past the window. Slight shake of a moving bus.

narration.am: በአውቶቡሱ መስኮት በኩል ተቀምጬ ነበር። ውጪው ደንና ተራራ ነው። እይታው ድንቅ ነበር።
narration.en: I sat by the window of the bus. Outside, forest and mountains. The view was amazing.

review.note: Draft written on 2026-11-25 from the story Bete told by voice that day. He has not read this line yet.

shots.title: Lamberet at night
shots.reason: The arrival, and the turn of the film: daylight and mountains give way to night, crowds, lit buildings and cars. He is alone in the frame, facing all of it. His friend is somewhere in that crowd, and the voice says so.

keyframe.prompt: Night on a wide avenue on the edge of Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. In the centre foreground, one young man seen from behind, a backpack on his shoulders, stands still and looks at the city in front of him. Before him the avenue is a river of white and red car lights with many blue and white minibus taxis, a thick crowd of people as soft dark shapes on both pavements, and tall concrete and glass buildings with hundreds of lit windows under a deep blue night sky.

motion.prompt: The two walk on while cars and people move around them. Slow pull back.

narration.am: ላምበረት ስደርስ መሽቶ ነበር። ጓደኛዬ እየጠበቀኝ ነበር። ሰው በዝቷል፤ የሕንፃ መብራት፣ ብዙ መኪና።
narration.en: It was night when I reached Lamberet. My friend was waiting for me. So many people, lights on the buildings, so many cars.

review.note: Draft written on 2026-11-25 from the story Bete told by voice that day. He has not read this line yet.

shots.title: Across the city
shots.reason: A breath between two crowded places, with no words: only the lights of a city he did not know yet, passing a window.

keyframe.prompt: An abstract painting of night city lights far out of focus, with no person, no figure and no object in it. The lights themselves are the subject: large soft round glows of amber, white, red and teal scattered over the whole frame on a dark blue-black ground, a few of them stretched sideways into short streaks by movement.

motion.prompt: City lights streak slowly past the window and reflections slide across the glass.

review.note: To check with Bete: that he and his friend went on from Lamberet to Autobus Tera the same night. He was not sure about the taxi, so no vehicle is named or shown from outside.

shots.title: Do you want a bed?
shots.reason: The heart of the story as he tells it: not fear but confusion. Brokers on every side offering a bed, and two friends who have to pick one.

keyframe.prompt: Night in the yard of a big crowded bus station in Addis Ababa. In the centre, seen from behind, two young men stand close together: the shorter one with a backpack, the other in a blue denim jacket with nothing on his back. Around them five men in a half circle lean in and gesture with open hands. The five are painted as dark silhouettes against the bright yard lamps, with no faces to be seen. Behind them rows of parked long-distance buses and dust hanging in the light.

motion.prompt: The men around them gesture and step closer. Slow push in.

narration.am: አውቶቡስ ተራ ስንደርስ ደላሎች ከበቡን። «አልጋ ትፈልጋላችሁ?» ብዙ ነበሩ። ግራ ገባን። አንዱን መረጥን።
narration.en: At Autobus Tera the brokers closed in on us. "Do you want a bed?" There were so many. We were confused. We picked one.

review.note: Draft written on 2026-11-25 from the story Bete told by voice that day. He has not read this line yet.

shots.title: The room
shots.reason: Quiet after the noise, and exactly as he described it: one bed, not very good, not bad, clean. The backpack is the only thing of his in it.

keyframe.prompt: A small plain rented room at night in Addis Ababa: one narrow single bed with one pillow and a clean sheet, neatly made, bare painted walls, a single bulb, a simple backpack on the floor beside the bed, one small window. Modest and clean.

motion.prompt: Very slow push in toward the bed and the backpack.

narration.am: ክፍሉ ባለ አንድ አልጋ ነበር። በጣም ጥሩ አይደለም፣ መጥፎም አይደለም። ንጹሕ ነበር።
narration.en: The room had one bed. Not very good, not bad. It was clean.

review.note: Draft written on 2026-11-25 from the story Bete told by voice that day. He has not read this line yet.

shots.title: The queue
shots.reason: The morning after: the city is ordinary again, a long line of people waiting for a ticket. He is the last one in it, seen from behind.

keyframe.prompt: Early morning in the open yard of a bus station in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, soft gold light and long shadows. In the foreground, one young man seen from behind, a backpack on his shoulders, stands at the end of a very long single-file queue. The queue of men and women, all seen from behind, runs away from him across the yard to a small ticket window in a low building far off. Long-distance buses are parked along one side.

motion.prompt: The queue shuffles forward a step. Slow pan along the line.

narration.am: ጠዋት ረጅም ሰልፍ ተሰልፈን ትኬት ቆረጥን።
narration.en: In the morning we stood in a long queue and got the ticket.

review.note: Draft written on 2026-11-25 from the story Bete told by voice that day. He has not read this line yet. To check: that his friend stood in the queue with him, and where the ticket was for.

shots.title: Now
shots.reason: The answer to the whole night, in two words of his. The same city, seen calmly by the man that boy became, with the same kind of backpack at his feet.

keyframe.prompt: Golden hour. One man alone, seen from behind, stands at the railing of a balcony and looks out over the wide city of Addis Ababa: low tin-roofed houses mixed with mid-rise concrete and glass buildings, and eucalyptus-covered hills on the horizon. A simple backpack rests on the floor beside his feet and nothing is on his back. Calm warm light.

motion.prompt: A light wind moves his shirt and the first city lights come on far away. Slow push in.

narration.am: ዛሬ ያንን ልጅ ባገኘው አንድ ነገር ብቻ እለዋለሁ፦ ኑረው።
narration.en: If I met that boy today, I would tell him just one thing: experience it.
